cases.situation: Coworker keeps DMing me on Slack about a trade he just made in his fantasy football league while I'm trying to finish a deck due at 4. Nice guy, don't want to be rude.
cases.reply: Ha, that trade is bold. I'm going heads-down on this deck until 4, so I'll be quiet for a bit. Tell me how it plays out.
cases.note: A real reason because you're cutting in mid-flow, and a forward hook instead of a question.

cases.situation: 友達と夜中までLINEしてて、もう寝たい。相手は恋愛の相談中で、まだ続きそうな雰囲気。
cases.reply: 話してくれてありがとう。ちゃんと聞きたいのに、もう頭が回らなくなってきた。続きは明日の夜、電話で聞かせてもらってもいい？今日はおやすみ。
cases.note: 重い話ほど「もう限界だから、ちゃんと聞ける時に」と正直に言うほうが、中途半端に返すより誠実です。

cases.situation: Told a guy from a dating app I'm heading to bed after he'd been texting me for two hours. He replied 'wow ok, guess I'm boring you'. I do like him.
cases.reply: Not a brush-off, I promise. I'm just done for the day. Talk tomorrow.
cases.note: Give warmth without retracting the exit, and don't end on a question that restarts the thread.

cases.situation: 我妈每次打电话都能聊一个多小时，今晚我还得赶一个方案。想挂电话，又怕她觉得我嫌她烦。
cases.reply: 妈，我得挂了，今晚还有个方案要赶出来。挂之前跟您说一声，周六我回家吃饭，想吃您做的红烧肉。好啦，您早点休息，拜拜。
cases.note: 电话里先说要走，补一句最后的话，再说拜拜就挂，不用等她先挂，也不用反复道别。

cases.situation: Sam, a friend of a friend I met once at a wedding, messaged me on Instagram to congratulate me on my new job. We've been chatting for an hour and he's nice, but I don't want this to turn into a regular thing.
cases.reply: Thanks again for the congrats, Sam, it was really nice to hear from you. I'm going to sign off now. Take care.
cases.note: An ending without a future hook: a warm recap and a clean close, no 'let's catch up soon' you don't mean, and no question that restarts it.

cases.situation: Video call with a client, Martin. The agenda was done 15 minutes ago and he keeps telling stories about his sailing trip. I have another call at 3 and it's 2:52.
cases.reply: Martin, I need to jump off in a couple of minutes for a 3 o'clock. Great session today, and I'll send the revised timeline by Thursday. Enjoy the sailing. Talk soon, bye.
cases.note: A recap line signals the ending, the real reason is given because you're cutting in, and the last line is not a question.

cases.situation: 儿子乐乐在少儿足球队踢了两年，去年就不踢了，但家长微信群还在，每天几十条消息。群里家长人都挺好的，想退群又不想显得突然。
cases.reply: 各位家长好，乐乐已经不在队里踢球了，我就先退群啦。这两年谢谢大家的照顾。有事随时私信我！
cases.note: 退群时一句真实原因加一句感谢就够了，不用多解释，最后一句不要用问句。

cases.situation: I'm at an industry conference mixer and a software sales rep, Phil, has been pitching me for 20 minutes. I'm not interested, and I just saw my former colleague Ana walk in. How do I get out of this?
cases.reply: Phil, I'm going to go catch Ana before she disappears. Thanks for walking me through it. Enjoy the rest of the conference.
cases.note: In person: a true reason, a warm close, and no question at the end. If he asks to book a demo, one line: 'I'll pass for now, thanks.' Then go.

cases.situation: Mein Nachbar Herr Becker (über 80, lebt allein) fängt mich fast jeden Abend im Treppenhaus ab und erzählt eine halbe Stunde. Ich mag ihn, aber heute habe ich schwere Einkaufstüten in der Hand, mit Tiefkühlsachen drin.
cases.reply: Herr Becker, ich muss jetzt hoch, sonst tauen mir die Tiefkühlsachen weg. Am Samstag bringe ich Ihnen die Zeitung mit hoch, dann erzählen Sie mir den Rest. Einen schönen Abend!
cases.note: Ein echter Grund, ein warmer Satz und ein fester Anknüpfungspunkt statt einer Frage. Redet er weiter: einmal kurz antworten, dann wirklich gehen.

cases.situation: 周六在家请朋友吃饭，已经12点半了，老同学阿伟和他老婆还在沙发上聊，刚又开了一瓶酒。我们俩都累了，明天中午还要去我妈家吃饭。
cases.reply: 今天真的太开心了，谢谢你们俩过来！我得收个尾了，我们俩有点撑不住，明天中午还要去我妈那儿吃饭。下次换你们家，我这就帮你们叫车。
cases.note: 做主人也要自己收尾：先暖暖地总结一句，再给真实的理由，最后用一个具体动作（叫车）结束，而不是等对方领会暗示。

cases.situation: I'm on a five-hour flight to Denver and the woman next to me, Linda, has been chatting for about an hour, mostly about her granddaughter's dance recital. She's lovely, but I need to sleep before a presentation first thing tomorrow. What do I say?
cases.reply: It's been really nice chatting, Linda. I've got a presentation first thing tomorrow, so I'm going to put my headphones in and try to sleep for a bit. I hope the recital is wonderful.
cases.note: When you can't physically leave, a warm recap plus a visible signal (headphones in) closes it; don't end on a question.

cases.situation: A salesman from a solar panel company called my mobile and has been talking for five minutes about a free roof survey. I don't want one, and I'd rather they didn't call again. How do I get off the phone?
cases.reply: Thanks, I'm going to stop you there. I'm not interested in a survey, and please take this number off your call list. Bye now.
cases.note: A clean close with no hook: no reason to argue with, one request to be removed, then say bye and hang up without waiting for him to finish.

cases.situation: I run a small bike repair shop. A regular, Gerald, has been chatting at the counter for 20 minutes about his cycling trip in the Alps while three customers wait behind him. His bike is in for a new chain, ready Thursday after 2. He's lovely and spends a lot here.
cases.reply: Gerald, I want the rest of the Alps story, but I've got a queue building and these folks have been patient. Your chain will be ready Thursday after 2. Come by then and tell me the rest.
cases.note: In a service setting, name the queue as the reason, give him the next concrete touchpoint, and turn to the next customer as you finish the sentence.

cases.situation: I agreed to a 30-minute Zoom with a grad student, Leo, who wants advice on getting into UX research. We're at 50 minutes, it's 6pm, and he keeps saying 'just one more question'. I have nothing after this, I'm just done for the day.
cases.reply: Leo, I'm going to wrap us up here, we're well past our half hour and I'm done for the day. The short version of everything: run two small studies for your portfolio before you apply anywhere. Once you've started the first one, email me one question and I'll reply within the week. Good luck, you're asking the right things.
cases.note: No invented next meeting: own the exit, recap in one line, and give one bounded way to follow up instead of 'reach out anytime'.

cases.situation: 国庆家庭聚餐，二舅又开始劝我辞职考公，越说越激动，桌上其他人都不说话了。我不想跟他吵，只想把这个话题结束掉。
cases.reply: 二舅，您的意思我都听明白了，也知道您是为我好。这个话题今天就先聊到这儿，我自己会好好想想。我去厨房帮忙端菜。
cases.note: 话题变成争论时：先收下好意，再明确说聊到这儿，用一个真实的动作离开，最后不留问句。

cases.situation: 国庆假期第一天，同事小陈在微信上跟我聊下个月的项目排期，已经四十分钟了，我正带孩子在公园。事情不急，节后再说完全来得及。
cases.reply: 小陈，排期的大思路我清楚了，谢谢你先捋了一遍。我这会儿在公园带孩子，先聊到这儿，剩下的节后上班第一天我们再对一下。假期愉快！
cases.note: 假期里的工作聊天：先用一句总结收尾，说真实原因，给一个节后的具体时间，最后不留问句。

cases.situation: A guy I don't know, Mark, has been arguing with me in the comments of my LinkedIn post about remote work, twelve replies back and forth now. I've made my point and I want to stop, without the last word looking like a jab or just disappearing.
cases.reply: Thanks for the back and forth, Mark. I think we've both made our case and we'll land in different places on this one, so I'm going to leave it here. All the best.
cases.note: In public, other people read the close: no last point, no question, and no reply if he keeps going.

cases.situation: Our website project with a freelance developer, Oksana, wrapped up last Friday and her final invoice is paid. Today she's emailed me three times with extra thoughts and small questions, none of which need any action. I want to close the thread kindly; we're planning a redesign next year and I'd like to hire her again.
cases.reply: Hi Oksana, thanks for all the extra thoughts, and for a project that ran smoothly from start to finish. None of these need anything from our side, so I'm going to close this thread here. We're planning a redesign next year and you're at the top of my list when it starts. Have a great week.
cases.note: An email close: recap, say plainly nothing is needed, a real forward hook, and no question at the end.

cases.situation: Two volunteers canvassing for a local election campaign knocked on my door and we've been talking on the doorstep for 15 minutes. I've already decided how I'm voting and the kids' dinner is on the stove. I want to close it politely without getting into a debate.
cases.reply: Thanks for coming round and taking the time to explain it all. I've already made up my mind, and I've got the kids' dinner on, so I'm going to leave it there. Good luck with the rest of the street.
cases.note: Nothing to argue with and no question at the end; say it, smile, and close the door.

cases.situation: At our company offsite dinner, the CFO, Diane, has been talking to me one-on-one for 40 minutes about her daughter's college applications. I'm flattered, but my team is at the other table and it's Priya's last night with us before she leaves the company. I want to go over without it looking like I'm brushing off the CFO.
cases.reply: Diane, this has been a real treat, and good luck to your daughter with the applications. I'm going to go join my team, it's Priya's last night with us and I want to raise a glass with her. Enjoy the rest of the evening.
cases.note: With someone senior, a warm recap and a true reason you can say out loud; you don't need them to release you.

cases.situation: 晚上十点，领导王总在微信上跟我聊明年的业务想法，已经半个多小时了，都不是急事。我想结束聊天去休息，但他是领导，不想显得敷衍。
cases.reply: 王总，您说的这几个方向我都记下了，明天上午我整理成一页发给您。时间不早了，我先休息，您也早点休息。
cases.note: 用一个具体的下一步代替“好的好的”，结束得有交代，最后一句不带问题。

cases.situation: I'm waiting for the last train home at 11pm and a man I don't know has been chatting to me on the platform for ten minutes. He just asked which stop I get off at and whether I live alone, and I feel uneasy. How do I end this?
cases.reply: I'm going to stop chatting now. Have a good night.
cases.note: No reason and no question; then move towards staff or other people, and if he follows you or you feel in danger, call emergency services.

cases.situation: 同事小李在茶水间拉着我吐槽另一个同事阿杰，说他抢功劳，已经十分钟了。我不想跟着说别人坏话，而且下午两点那个会的材料我还没弄完。
cases.reply: 这事你跟阿杰当面聊聊可能更清楚。我得回工位了，两点那个会的材料还没弄完。回头见！
cases.note: 不接话、不评价阿杰，用真实的理由收尾，最后一句不带问题。

cases.situation: I'm visiting my friend Nadia in hospital two days after her knee surgery. We've talked for over an hour, she's started yawning and wincing when she shifts, but she keeps saying 'stay a bit longer'. I want to leave so she can rest, and I'm coming back on Sunday with the crossword book she asked for.
cases.reply: Nadia, this has been the best hour of my week, and I'm going to head off so you can rest. That knee needs you sleeping more than it needs me talking. I'll be back on Sunday with the crossword book. Sleep well.
cases.note: Leave while it's still good; if she asks again, one warm 'Sunday, I promise' and go.

cases.situation: 我是小学三年级班主任。晚上十点多，家长浩浩妈妈还在微信上跟我聊浩浩写作业磨蹭的事，已经四十分钟了。我建议她每天把作业分成三段、每段中间休息五分钟，先试一周，主要的话都说完了，我也累了想休息。
cases.reply: 浩浩妈妈，今天聊得很细，看得出您对浩浩特别上心。就按我们说的，每天作业分三段，每段中间休息五分钟，先试一周。时间不早了，我先休息了，一周后您发条消息跟我说说效果就行。晚安！
cases.note: 老师跟家长聊天也可以自己收尾：一句总结、一个真实理由、一个明确的下次，最后不留问句。

cases.situation: Vivo en Madrid y mi primo Rodrigo, que vive en Ciudad de México, me escribe por WhatsApp cada noche a las 7 de su hora, que aquí son las 3 de la madrugada. Ahora mismo me está contando lo de su nuevo piso y yo entro a trabajar a las 8.
cases.reply: Primo, qué bien lo del piso, me alegro mucho. Aquí son las 3 de la madrugada y entro a trabajar a las 8, así que me voy a dormir. El sábado te llamo a las 10 de tu mañana y me lo enseñas por videollamada. Un abrazo.
cases.note: Con diferencia horaria, nombra tu hora y propone un momento que sirva a los dos; si sigue escribiendo, contesta mañana.

cases.situation: 闺蜜小雨今晚在微信上连发了十几条一分钟的语音，吐槽家里装修的事，最后说她决定换施工队了。我都听完了，主要的事已经聊完，我明早7点要赶高铁，想睡了。
cases.reply: 小雨，你那几条语音我都听完了，换施工队这个决定我觉得挺对的。我明早7点要赶高铁，得先睡了。到了给你发消息，晚安！
cases.note: 一句总结表示都听进去了，再说真实的理由；最后不留问句，免得又来一轮语音。

cases.situation: I've been in a Discord voice channel with my raid group for four hours and it's past 1am. I have a statistics exam at 9 tomorrow morning, and we already agreed to raid again Sunday at 8pm. They're planning the next run and I don't want to just vanish from the call.
cases.reply: Great run tonight, everyone, that last boss was a proper team kill. I've got a stats exam at 9, so I'm logging off now. See you Sunday at 8. Night!
cases.note: Say it on voice, type it in the channel, then actually leave the call; one goodbye is enough.

cases.situation: First date with Daniel from a dating app at a wine bar. We've been here an hour and a half, there's no spark for me, and he just suggested ordering another bottle. I want to leave now without hinting we'll do it again.
cases.reply: I'm going to call it a night. Thanks for the drink, Daniel, it was nice to meet you. Take care getting home.
cases.note: No future hook and no fake excuse; if he asks about a second date, one honest line ('I don't think we're a match, but I enjoyed meeting you') and go.

cases.situation: Toda vez que vou buscar meu filho Davi na escola, a Cristina, mãe de uma colega dele, me segura uns 20 minutos no portão falando da reforma da casa dela. Hoje o Davi tem natação às 17h30 e já são 17h05. Ela é simpática, não quero ser grosseira.
cases.reply: Cristina, preciso ir agora, o Davi tem natação às 17h30. Boa sorte com a reforma, depois você me conta o resto. Tchau, até amanhã!
cases.note: No portão da escola: motivo real, um gancho leve e nenhuma pergunta no final; diga tchau e vá andando.

cases.situation: My grandad Albert is 88 and video calls me every Sunday at 4. After about an hour he gets tired, but he doesn't know how to end the call, so he keeps saying 'well, anyway' and starting a new story. We'll talk again next Sunday at 4, and I want to show him my photos from Lisbon then.
cases.reply: Grandad, this has been lovely, and I'm going to say goodbye now. Next Sunday at 4 I'll show you my photos from Lisbon. I'll press the button to hang up on my end, so you don't need to do anything. Bye for now, love you.
cases.note: When someone struggles to end a call, close it for them: a warm recap, the next date, and you do the hanging up.

cases.situation: I host a monthly book club on Zoom for ten people, scheduled 7 to 8pm. It's now 8:20, we finished discussing the book a while ago, side chats keep starting up, and nobody wants to be the first to leave. Next meeting is Thursday 5 November and the book is The Glass Orchard.
cases.reply: Okay everyone, I'm going to wrap us up there, we're well past eight. Thank you for a really good discussion tonight. Next time is Thursday 5 November, and we're reading The Glass Orchard. Night, all!
cases.note: In a group call, the host closes for everyone: a recap, the next date, then end the meeting for all instead of waiting for the last person to leave.
